question_text: Maria was born in 1990 in the Philippines to a Filipino mother and an alien father (Japanese). At the time of her birth, the 1987 Constitution was in effect. Which of the following statements about Maria's citizenship is correct?

options.text: Maria is a Filipino citizen because she was born in the Philippines.
Maria is a Japanese citizen because her father is Japanese.
Maria is a Filipino citizen because the Constitution grants citizenship to children of Filipino mothers regardless of the father's citizenship.
Maria is not a Filipino citizen because her father is an alien.
